thread:
Sam W: Quick follow-up from the postmortem — we need concrete owners and timelines for streaming/chat reliability fixes (timeouts, partial responses, reconnect logic). I'll propose items, please claim or suggest changes.

Maya K: Agree. Let's separate infra vs client so work can run in parallel. Infra = timeouts/keepalive tuning + server-side reconnect handling. Client = backoff + resume logic.

Priya S: I can own client reconnects and resume. Plan: add exponential backoff + jitter, max 5 retries, and resume token support in the SDK. Target: PR by Fri COB. @Sam W tagging for priority. :thumbsup:

Jorge A: I'll take infra timeouts. First step: increase stream socket keepalive and extend server-side idle window for long-running responses. Running a cluster soak test today to measure impact. ETA: 3 business days for config patch + canary.

Lucy H: I'll handle QA and regression tests for partial responses. Need a canonical prompt set and some synthetic long-response cases. Can we surface a failing example in this thread?

Sam W: Example partial response repro (from the postmortem):
```
client: start_stream(chat_id=abc123)
server: tokens... up to 245 tokens
network: connection reset
client: receives RST, no final event
```
We want the client to detect incomplete finalization and retry/resume automatically.

Priya S: Proposed backoff snippet for SDK (will include in PR):
```
retry_delay = min(2 ** attempts + random_jitter(), 30)
if attempts > 0: resume_stream(token=last_ack)
```

Maya K: Observability items: add per-connection trace_id and a "partial_response" metric with tags {model, region, route}. That'll let us detect regressions and correlate with infra changes. I can own the dashboard + alert. ETA: 5 days.

oncall-bot: Incident INC-2026-3241 created and linked: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-3241

Jorge A: Quick note from soak: reducing keepalive interval stopped ~70% of socket resets in eu-west-1, but we saw a small latency bump for tiny responses. Will tune and push config to canary.

Sam W: Risk assessment: config-only changes are low risk but we should have a rollback plan. Priya, include a feature flag for client resume. Maya, plan a 2-hour canary window and rollback criteria. Lucy, hold off broad QA until canary passes.

Lucy H: Will prepare regression harness and add probes to simulate mid-stream drops. ETA for harness: 48 hours.

Priya S: Opening tracker now: RDW-8112 "SDK: auto-resume + backoff" — assigning to me, target Fri. Will include feature flag and integration test.

Maya K: Dashboard ticket RDW-8113 "streaming partial_response metric + dashboard" assigned to me, ETA next Wed.

Jorge A: Config change ticket RDW-8114 "server keepalive tuning + canary" assigned to me, pushing canary tomorrow morning.

Sam W: Owners and timelines recap:
- Infra timeouts/config: Jorge A — 3 days (RDW-8114)
- Client resume/backoff: Priya S — Fri COB (RDW-8112)
- Observability + alerting: Maya K — next Wed (RDW-8113)
- QA/regression harness: Lucy H — 48h

Sam W: Action: everyone drop a short status update in this thread at EOD today and then daily until canary + metrics look green. If you need to reassign, say so here.

Priya S: Acked — will post PR link when ready.

Jorge A: Acked, will post canary results here after the morning run.

Lucy H: Acked, will attach test plan and sample prompts.

Maya K: Acked. Will add rollback runbook to RDW-8113. :white_check_mark:
